title: Add deep link to open the Live Camera recording view

requirements.text: Enable opening the Live page directly in Camera Recording mode when the user requests “Open live camera”, by supporting a URL/deep-link that selects the Live page’s Camera Recording tab on first render.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the Live page with a query parameter (e.g. /live?mode=camera) opens the Live page with the 'Camera Recording' tab selected.
Navigating to /live with no query parameter continues to default to the existing 'Simulated Live Feed' tab.
Switching tabs in the UI keeps working as it does now and does not break the simulated polling pause/refetch behavior.
All user-facing text related to this behavior is in English.

requirements.text: Add an in-app UI affordance to open the camera recording view from within the Live page without manual tab switching (e.g., a button or link labeled in English).
acceptanceCriteria: Live page includes a clearly labeled control (English text) that switches the Live page into 'Camera Recording' mode when clicked.
The control does not start the camera automatically; it only switches to the camera tab so the user can click 'Enable Camera'.
The existing bottom tab navigation and desktop navigation remain unchanged and continue to route to /live.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not add WebSockets or external services; keep behavior fully in-browser and within the existing React/TanStack Router structure.
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Implementing a server-side video ingestion, upload, or analytics pipeline for recorded camera footage.
Changing backend APIs or adding new backend storage for recordings.
Automatically starting camera capture without an explicit user click on 'Enable Camera'.
